subject: gen z
one_liner: The AI-native editor for your group chats. Press Tab and it texts back for you.
brand_voice_notes: Pitched like a serious dev-tools company with a waitlist and a Series B. Every developer-tool concept (autocomplete, linting, agents, model pickers, diffs) is applied with total sincerity to texting your friends. The product has strong opinions about full stops. Never use slang to sound young; the joke is that a very grown-up company is shipping it.

hero.h1: Your group chat, now with autocomplete.
hero.sub: Lowkey reads the last 40 messages, predicts what you were about to say, and says it in a tone you were never going to manage on your own. Press Tab. Go back to sleep.
hero.primary_cta: Download for iPhone and your friend's iPhone

features.title: Tab to reply
features.blurb: Ghost text appears in the reply box before you finish reading the message. 71% of users accept it without reading the message at all. Our board considers this a retention metric.

features.title: Vibe linter
features.blurb: Pink squiggles flag anything that reads as over 30: full stops, 'haha', replying within the hour, sincerity. Every warning ships with a one-click quick fix.

features.title: Agent mode
features.blurb: Give Lowkey a goal like 'get out of brunch' and it opens four chats, negotiates on your behalf, and leaves one of them on read for realism. You approve the diff.

demo_screen_concept: A three-pane code editor where the files are group chats. Left: an Explorer tree of .chat files (the-council.chat, mum.chat, situationship.chat with an unsaved dot, work-do-not-open.chat). Center: the selected thread rendered as numbered lines with syntax-coloured senders, and a reply line at the bottom showing grey ghost-text completion with a Tab keycap; Tab accepts, Esc rejects, Alt+] cycles through alternatives. Right: a Problems panel from the vibe linter ('full stop detected, reads as furious', 'reply sent 4 minutes after receipt, appears eager') with Quick Fix buttons that rewrite the line. Top bar: a model picker (lowkey-unbothered, lowkey-chaos, lowkey-mum-safe) and a 'rizz temperature' slider. An Agent button opens a modal where you type a goal and watch a fake step log negotiate your way out of brunch.

design_direction.style: Y2K cyber-pastel dev tool, lilac daylight mode. An AI code editor's marketing site dressed in early-2000s instant-messenger nostalgia that Gen Z inherited secondhand: a pale lilac ground, chrome-bubble stickers, a periwinkle 'electric' primary, hot-pink squiggles, a wide geometric display face and monospace editor text. Explicitly absent, because the last seven entries used them: sale-bill stacks, lot boxes, manicules, misregistration, activity rings, waveforms, readout chips, collar bands, aisle signs, shelf tags, pallet beams, scorecard grids, stitch seams, pencil notes, pennants, stud tiles, brass hairlines, velvet ropes, leaf corners, sleep rings, 3px ink outlines with hard offset shadows. Also absent: dark page backgrounds (the editor window is the only dark surface), serif type, paper textures, condensed signage type, handwriting. Four motifs carry the page. (1) Ghost text: grey italic completions trail after real copy, followed by a small chunky Tab keycap. (2) The vibe squiggle: a hot-pink wavy underline (text-decoration wavy) marks the one 'problem' word per section. (3) The chrome bubble: glossy silver-to-lilac blob stickers, the only gradients anywhere, used behind the hero window and the highlighted tier. (4) The read receipt: tiny 'Seen 3:12am' timestamps in mono under testimonials and CTAs. Corners 18px on cards, 10px on the editor window, 999px on pills.

fonts.body: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

design_direction.archetype: Developer-tool SaaS landing (Cursor/Linear school): centered hero with a large product window, logo strip, feature rows with inline mockups, pricing table, testimonials, closing CTA.
design_direction.motion_vocab: Ghost text types itself in once on load and the Tab keycap presses down; squiggles draw in; chrome bubbles drift a few px on a slow loop. All motion disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Huge two-line Syne headline centered, the word 'autocomplete' followed by grey ghost text '...and also your personality' and a Tab keycap. Below, a dark editor window floating on two chrome bubbles shows a group chat as code with a completion being accepted.
